# Tool logos

Drawn into the README artwork by `theme.py` (the toolbox, the link buttons, and the glyphs on the stat cards). Each logo belongs to its owner and is used here only to name the tool.

- Most files: the [Iconify `logos` set](https://github.com/gilbarbara/logos) (CC0), fetched from `https://api.iconify.design/logos/<name>.svg`. Where the file name differs from the set's name: `azure.svg` is `microsoft-azure`, `mongodb.svg` is `mongodb-icon`, `astro.svg` is `astro-icon`, `terraform.svg` is `terraform-icon`, `argocd.svg` is `argo-icon`, `sentry.svg` is `sentry-icon` and `clickup.svg` is `clickup-icon`.
- `k3s.svg`: [Simple Icons](https://simpleicons.org/) (CC0) via Iconify (`simple-icons:k3s`), with its fill set to black so `theme.py` recolours it for the dark theme.
- `nextjs.svg`: Simple Icons (CC0) via Iconify (`simple-icons:nextdotjs`), with its fill set to black so `theme.py` recolours it for the dark theme.
- `instagram.svg`: [Skill Icons](https://github.com/tandpfun/skill-icons) (MIT), from Iconify.
- `ui/`: [Lucide](https://lucide.dev/) glyphs (ISC), from `https://api.iconify.design/lucide/<name>.svg`.

## Project icons (`projects/`)

The featured projects' own icons, copied from their repos: `kv.svg` (key-vault-for-llm, `docs/images/logo.svg`), `telegram-mcp.svg` (telegram-mcp, `docs/icon.svg`) and `server-dash.svg` (server-dash, `frontend/public/favicon.svg`). Bridge Relay has no icon of its own; its card uses the Lucide `cable` glyph.

## Title font

The section titles and the name in the banner are outlines of [Fredoka](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/fredoka) (SIL Open Font License 1.1), stored in `../titles.json` by `../make_titles.py`. The font file itself is not in this repo.
